author: Dr Ben Miles
description:
Scientists have developed a perovskite solar panel coated with a thin fluorinated film that not only protects it from water damage but also generates electricity from raindrop impacts. This hybrid technology converts mechanical energy from rain into electrical power, supplementing solar energy and proving useful for autonomous outdoor devices.

Source Article: https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S2211285525010377?via%3Dihub#ec0005
